Your community will likely appreciate the effort you put into making something special, regardless of how much it costs. Remember, the goal of the community harvest celebration is to come together and share in the spirit of gratitude and community, not to put a strain on your family's budget. I hope these suggestions help, and I'm sure your contribution will be appreciated, no matter what!
